fact: On 18 March 2025 the CNDP launched hearings of institutions, professional associations, political parties and experts on personal data protection and artificial intelligence, to gather their views ahead of a deliberation, with sittings listed from June to December 2025.
title: IA & Protection des données à caractère Personnel
publisher: Commission Nationale de Contrôle de la Protection des Données à Caractère Personnel (CNDP)
